headline_ja: 葉物野菜が6月の1.5〜2倍、コメは4割安
headline_en: Leafy vegetables at 1.5–2x June levels while rice sits 40% lower
summary_ja: 約1か月ぶりの観測（前回は9月16日）。単一店舗（東京近郊・ライフ）の店頭で、基準日2026-06-04比の食品指数は基調(excl)108.51、特売込(incl)109.66だった。押し上げたのは野菜で、にら・白菜・レタス・小松菜・きゅうりの5品が基準比+44〜+81%。豆腐・納豆も+10〜+21%と上がった。一方、コメ（つや姫5kg）は基準比−41%で、野菜の上昇の一部を打ち消している。果物・肉は基準日と同じ価格だった。マッチした品は33〜37。魚介類・酒類・飲料は当日に基準日と同じ商品を確認できず、この3分類は指数から外して残り7分類で平均している（当日観測できていないウェイトは基調で30%）。前回とは欠けた分類が異なるため、前回からの差には分類の違いも混ざる。これは観測であって予測ではなく、単一店舗のため全国を代表しない。
summary_en: The first observation in about a month (prior: September 16). At a single Tokyo-area store (Life), the food index versus the 2026-06-04 base read 108.51 for the promotion-excluded core (excl) and 109.66 including promotions (incl). Vegetables drove the rise: garlic chives, Chinese cabbage, lettuce, komatsuna and cucumber were up 44–81% on the base. Tofu and natto rose 10–21%. Rice (Tsuyahime 5kg) was 41% below the base, offsetting part of the vegetable increase. Fruit and meat were unchanged from the base. 33–37 items matched. Seafood, alcohol and beverages had no item matching the base on the day, so those three categories are left out and the index averages the remaining seven (30% of the core basket weight was not observed). The missing categories differ from the prior observation, so the change since then also reflects which categories were observed. This is an observation, not a forecast, and a single store is not nationally representative.
